request.premise: A neighborhood repair cooperative discovers a payment shortfall at closing time, and the partner who hid the warning must choose whether to share it.

characters.identity_summary: A 42-year-old mechanic who keeps the cooperative weekly accounts and refuses to be surprised twice in one lifetime.
relevant_background_history: He watched his father's repair stall close without warning after a cash crisis.
He rebuilt the cooperative with his younger sister Mara and made shared warnings a condition of the partnership.
characters.social_context: Older brother and equal partner in a four-person cooperative whose livelihoods depend on the books he keeps.

relationships.history: They rebuilt the workshop together after their father closed his stall.
relationships.present_tension: He has found a missing payment notice she has not shared.
relationships.dependency: He needs her technical leadership; she needs his financial discipline.

wants.external: Get an honest book and a payroll plan the team can act on tonight.
wants.internal: Prove that silence can never again turn a solvable problem into a sudden closure.

beliefs: Shared warnings are the only proof that a partnership is real.
characters.emotional_wound: He was away when his father's stall closed and learned it from a padlocked door.
characters.mistaken_belief: If he personally checks every number, nobody can ever be blindsided.
contradictions: Preaches shared responsibility but grabs the ledger before asking for help.
habits: Rubs a grease stain on his thumb while choosing words
Points at an empty total instead of accusing

voice.rhythm: Measured, low, economical; short sentences that wait for an answer.
voice.vocabulary: Concrete workshop and bookkeeping words; no jargon.
voice.restraint: Asks one exact question rather than naming the feeling.

characters.behavior_under_pressure: Becomes unusually quiet and turns toward the paperwork instead of the person.
characters.appearance_traits: Black man, close-cut hair, trimmed beard, steady planted stance.

identity_visual.face: Broad calm face, level eyes, trimmed beard
identity_visual.wardrobe_rules: Work shirt with sleeves rolled; no jewelry beyond a plain watch
identity_visual.continuity_constraints: Same beard length and watch in every scene
identity_visual.prompt_block: Levi Bell, Black man, 42, close-cut hair, trimmed beard, work shirt, steady stance.

spoken_dialogue.text: The total is short and you already knew.
I knew on Tuesday and I did not want to frighten the team.
I can wait one more week for my repair if it keeps your people paid.
Then I will tell everyone tonight before they hear it another way.

identities.identity_summary: A 38-year-old repair-cooperative owner who can fix a motor faster than she can admit a mistake.
relevant_background_history: She helped her father close his repair stall after an avoidable cash crisis.
She built the cooperative with her older brother Levi and promised the team would never be surprised again.
identities.social_context: Responsible for a small team that has trusted her with its livelihoods.

relationships.present_tension: She has withheld a payment warning he needs for payroll.
relationships.dependency: She trusts his judgment and fears his disappointment.

wants.external: Keep the cooperative open and pay the team on Friday.
wants.internal: Be trusted without having to appear infallible.

beliefs: A good leader absorbs the bad news before anyone else feels it.
identities.emotional_wound: She was the last person told that her father's stall was closing.
identities.mistaken_belief: A good leader protects everyone by solving problems alone.
contradictions: Demands clear estimates from apprentices while hiding the warning from her own partner.
habits: Straightens tools when avoiding a question
Taps the seam of a sealed envelope before opening it

voice.rhythm: Short practical sentences; explanations speed up when she is afraid.
voice.vocabulary: Concrete workshop language; avoids corporate jargon.
voice.restraint: Admits the fact before naming the feeling.

identities.behavior_under_pressure: Takes on more physical work and conceals paperwork until a concrete consequence forces disclosure.
identities.appearance_traits: Black woman, short natural curls, alert eyes, compact work-ready posture.

identity_visual.face: Angular alert face, quick level gaze
identity_visual.wardrobe_rules: Rolled-sleeve work shirt, canvas apron with pencil pocket
identity_visual.continuity_constraints: Same curls and pencil pocket throughout the episode
identity_visual.prompt_block: Mara Bell, Black woman, 38, short natural curls, canvas apron over work shirt.

identities.identity_summary: A 61-year-old regular customer who counts every dollar out loud and offers the one concession that makes Mara's turn possible.
relevant_background_history: She ran a market stall for twenty years and survived two thin seasons by scheduling payments instead of borrowing.
Her late husband's radio sits on her kitchen counter; she repairs it rather than replace it.
identities.occupation: Retired market-stall grocer, now a regular repair customer
identities.social_context: A long-standing neighborhood customer who knows the cooperative's people by name and holds no formal power over it.

relationships.history: Mara repaired her radio twice at cost.
relationships.present_tension: She suspects the cooperative cannot make its payroll and dislikes being managed.
relationships.dependency: She depends on the shop; the shop depends on customers like her.

wants.external: Get her radio repaired without pushing the cooperative under.
wants.internal: Be treated as an adult who can carry bad news.

fears: Being handled with a cheerful half-truth
Watching another small shop vanish quietly
beliefs: People can bear the truth if you give them time to plan.
identities.emotional_wound: Her stall's landlord raised rent without notice and she lost the lease in a fortnight.
identities.mistaken_belief: If she offers to sacrifice first, nobody will have to lie to her.
contradictions: Insists on exact honesty while softening her own offer so it sounds smaller than it is.
habits: Counts bills twice before folding them
Leaves her receipt on the counter as a small assertion

voice.rhythm: Unhurried, one clause at a time, with a pause before any offer.
voice.vocabulary: Market and household words; names exact amounts.
voice.restraint: States her concession plainly and never mentions what it costs her.

identities.behavior_under_pressure: Sits down, folds her hands and waits, forcing the other person to fill the silence.
identities.appearance_traits: South Asian woman, silver hair in a low bun, reading glasses on a chain, upright posture.

identity_visual.face: Rounded face, fine lines, attentive eyes behind thin frames
identity_visual.hair: silver hair in a low bun
identity_visual.wardrobe_rules: Cardigan over a plain blouse; reading glasses on a chain
identity_visual.continuity_constraints: Same glasses chain and bun in every appearance

cast.immediate_story_function: The partner who hid the warning must choose to expose it.
cast.choice_or_consequence: She tells the whole team tonight, trading control for shared responsibility.

relationship_changes.change: From protected from the truth to a partner who is trusted with it.

cast.immediate_story_function: He makes the missing money visible through the open ledger instead of accusing her.
cast.choice_or_consequence: His restrained offer of help makes Mara's disclosure survivable.

relationship_changes.change: Protective loyalty becomes a working partnership.

cast.immediate_story_function: She is singled out of the queue and offers a payment delay, proving the team can bear the truth.
cast.choice_or_consequence: Her concession turns Mara's private failure into a decision the room can share.

relationship_changes.change: From managed customer to a witness treated as an adult.

crowd_groups.composition: Three adult repair customers and one apprentice waiting near the counter.
crowd_groups.location_placement: Two seated beside the north wall, two standing at the counter, all outside the focus plane.
crowd_groups.collective_behavior: Quiet queue behavior; occasional low conversation that does not carry.
crowd_groups.permitted_motion: Shifting weight, looking toward the counter, checking a phone.
crowd_groups.attention_direction: Toward the counter and the ledger, never toward the camera.
crowd_groups.interaction_with_leads: No individual interaction; they remain background while Mara speaks.
crowd_groups.wardrobe_palette: Muted everyday clothes; no logos or uniforms implying a real company.
crowd_groups.camera_limits: Never in close-up, never holding a plot prop, never the focus of a shot.
crowd_groups.entry_exit_rule: Present at scene start; no individual entrance or exit is staged.
